notes.body: CURRENT STATUS FOR AMY: Meeteetse is an active Kristy-leg Labor Day opportunity, not yet fully confirmed. Dave signed the current contract on Aug. 27, 2026. The event-side signature/date are still blank, so do not treat it as fully contracted or calendar-confirmed yet. Current event/site contact shown on the contract: Codi-Brooke Robinson, Authorized Event Representative - Oasis Motel and RV Park, cell (214) 463-8506, office@meeteetsewy.com. Event dates are Sept. 5-7, 2026. Commercial structure is pay-for-play with no upfront entertainment fee to the event; Adventure Zone sets/collects public admission and pays the sponsoring event 10% of ticket-box sales within 24 hours after the final operating day. Current attraction commitment is 8-10 inflatables. Adventure Zone is to be the exclusive commercial inflatable attraction, amusement ride, and pay-to-play carnival game operator at the approved site. Site must accommodate the attractions, ticket box, safety clearances, circulation, emergency access, and loading/unloading. Event-side requirements include permission to arrive Sept. 3 and remain through Sept. 8 at midnight; (4) 220V 50-amp outlets or 24 separate 110V outlets within 150 feet, or a 50 kW generator; water within 150 feet; camping or suitable lodging; 24-hour restroom access; local/state permits and inspection costs; and a forklift/operator for reload if available. Final electrical plan and attraction/site layout still need confirmation. Amy's immediate goal is to reach Codi-Brooke, confirm the event's signature/acceptance, exact approved setup location/footprint and operating hours, and then move it to confirmed/calendar workflow once the signed contract is returned.
